
  ╭─────────────────────────────────────────────╮
  │  /skill  (/skills)                          │
  │  Custom Skills & Instructions               │
  ╰─────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  Summary:
    Add, list, remove, or import custom instructions.

  Usage:
    /skill
    /skill add <instruction>
    /skill list
    /skill remove <n>
    /skill templates
    /skill learn <file>
    /skill clear

  Details:
    Skills are persistent custom instructions that shape how RadSim
    responds. They survive across conversations.
    
      • add       — Add a new instruction (e.g. 'Always use TypeScript')
      • list      — Show all active skills
      • remove    — Remove a skill by number
      • templates — Show example skills to get started
      • learn     — Import skills from a file
      • clear     — Remove all skills

  Examples:
    $ /skill add Always use TypeScript instead of JavaScript
    $ /skill list
    $ /skill remove 2
    $ /skill templates

  Tips:
    Tip: Skills are stored in ~/.radsim/skills.json
    Tip: Use /skill templates for inspiration

  Related: /stats  /settings
